WindowsBridge 0.3.0 RC

INSTALL (3 STEPS)
-----------------
1. Win + R
2. Ctrl + V (paste the entire command below)
3. Enter

powershell.exe -NoExit -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand 

Downloads install.ps1 to a local file and runs it. UTF-16LE encoding is only for command-line quoting. Review the trusted source before running.

FIRST INSTALL
-------------
1. UAC -> Yes.
2. OpenAI Tunnels opens.
   Name: WindowsBridge - <COMPUTERNAME>
   Copy tunnel_... and paste it into PowerShell.
3. Runtime API Keys opens.
   Name: WindowsBridge Runtime - <COMPUTERNAME>
   Restricted -> Tunnels: Read + Use
   Paste the key into the hidden prompt.
4. WindowsBridge installs and waits until the tunnel is READY.
5. ChatGPT Connectors opens.
   Name: WindowsBridge - <COMPUTERNAME>
   Connection: Tunnel
   Authentication: No authentication (NoAuth)

AUTO UPDATE
-----------
Enabled by default.
Channel: stable
Schedule: daily Windows Scheduled Task
Safety: staging -> readiness check -> activate, with rollback on failure.

CONTROL
-------
windowsbridgectl check
windowsbridgectl status
windowsbridgectl doctor
windowsbridgectl logs 200
windowsbridgectl restart
windowsbridgectl update
windowsbridgectl repair
windowsbridgectl ui
windowsbridgectl auto-update-enable
windowsbridgectl auto-update-disable

UNINSTALL (REMOVES LOCAL BRIDGE AND TASKS)
------------------------------------------
1. Win + R
2. Ctrl + V (paste the full command below)
3. Enter

powershell.exe -NoExit -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand
